description:
Know what you pay for, and decide before every renewal.

Pausely keeps every subscription in one calm place. Before each charge it asks one question: keep it or cancel it? Every cancellation goes on your Savings Receipt, so you can see exactly what you saved.

WHAT YOU GET
• Renewal Verdicts: a reminder before every charge with what it costs a year, price changes, your usage and when you can cancel. Keep it or cancel it in one tap.
• Your Savings Receipt: every charge your cancellations avoided, with dates you can check
• Pause Plan: watch one streaming service at a time and rotate monthly. Pausely tells you when to cancel and when to start again.
• One clear dashboard with your weekly, monthly and yearly spend, your next payment and the bills due this week
• 1,000+ popular services to add in seconds, with their plans and prices
• Reminders 1, 3 or 7 days before, the day before and on the day
• Free-trial reminders before you'd be charged
• Cancel steps and direct links for 900+ services, free for everyone
• Price history for every subscription
• Cheaper alternatives for the services you already pay for
• Cost per hour of use, so you can see what's worth keeping
• 130+ currencies with automatic conversion
• Home Screen widgets and Shortcuts actions
• Your Subscription Wrapped: a year of subscriptions at a glance
• Export your data whenever you like

THE PAUSELY PROMISE
Pausely tracks its own subscription too. At renewal it shows what it saved you compared with what it costs, and if it isn't worth it, it tells you to cancel it.

FREE AND PRO
Track up to 5 subscriptions for free, with reminders, Renewal Verdicts, cancel help and your Savings Receipt. Pausely Pro adds unlimited subscriptions, Pause Plan, savings analysis and cheaper alternatives.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No ads, no third-party trackers, and we never sell your data. Your history and Savings Receipt stay on your iPhone.

Available in English, French, Spanish, German, Japanese and Arabic.

SUBSCRIPTION INFO
Pausely Pro is an auto-renewing subscription, billed monthly or yearly. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings after purchase.

Terms of Use: https://pausely.pro/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://pausely.pro/privacy.html
Support: pausely@proton.me
promotionalText: Before every renewal, Pausely asks: keep it or cancel it? Your Savings Receipt shows what you saved, and Pausely tells you to cancel it if it isn't worth it.
whatsNew:
• Renewal Verdicts: decide before every charge, right from the reminder
• Savings Receipt: see exactly what your cancellations saved
• Pause Plan: rotate your streaming services and pay for one at a time
• Cancel help is now free for everyone
• Reminders: Pausely now asks for notification permission when you add your first subscription
• A clearer subscription screen, service logos, more translations and many fixes
